SourceShort.title: SourceShort
SourceShort.description: A YouTube Short video imported by a creator for repurposing and cross-platform syndication.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator who owns this YouTube Short.

title.description: Original or customized title of the YouTube Short.

channelName.description: Source YouTube channel handle or name.

durationSec.description: Duration of the short video in seconds (1 to 180).

aspectMode.description: Framing and safe-zone crop mode for cross-platform output.

stripWatermark.description: Whether to strip platform watermarks and clean metadata headers.

normalizeAudioLufs.description: Whether to normalize audio loudness to -14 LUFS broadcast standard.

xCopy.description: Repurposed post copy optimized for X (Twitter) video posts.

reelsCaption.description: Repurposed caption and hashtag block for Instagram Reels.

tiktokCaption.description: Repurposed caption and searchable keywords for TikTok.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the short was imported.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the short was last modified.

ScheduledPost.title: ScheduledPost
ScheduledPost.description: A platform-specific scheduled or published video syndication job.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator who owns this scheduled job.

shortId.description: ID of the parent SourceShort document.

shortTitle.description: Denormalized title of the SourceShort for table display.

scheduledFor.description: ISO-8601 date-time string for scheduled execution.

status.description: Current execution state in the publishing pipeline.

autoFirstComment.description: Automated follow-up reply or first comment with source link.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the job was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the job was last updated.

AutomationRule.title: AutomationRule
AutomationRule.description: An automated cross-platform repurposing and scheduling workflow rule.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

name.description: Human-readable name of the automation pipeline.

sourceChannel.description: Source YouTube channel handle or playlist filter.

delayMinutes.description: Stagger delay in minutes after YouTube Short detection (0 to 10080).

stripWatermark.description: Automatically strip YouTube watermark and end-screen cards.

autoCaptions.description: Automatically burn dynamic captions into safe zone.

enabled.description: Whether the automation rule is currently active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the rule was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the rule was updated.

/shorts/{shortId}.description: Stores imported YouTube Shorts and their repurposed multi-platform presets.

/schedules/{scheduleId}.description: Stores scheduled and published syndication jobs for X, Instagram Reels, and TikTok.

/rules/{ruleId}.description: Stores automated trigger-to-publish rules per creator.
